correctness.rationale: An explicit all-d proof gives H^2=0, rank H=2^{d-1}, rank(H+P)=2^{d-1}+1, image(H+P)^2=span(e,He), and the exact two-dimensional restricted action. For even d this yields nilpotent Jordan blocks (3,2,...,2), one fixed line, and every first-entry shell; for odd d it yields one irreducible quadratic factor and size-two unipotent blocks giving the period-1/2/3/6 census. The standalone finite-dimensional verifier checks ranks and exhaustive state dynamics, but is not the infinite proof.
